_comment_outputDirectory: Directory where conversation markdown files will be saved (relative or absolute path)

formatting._comment_syntaxHighlighting: Enable syntax highlighting in code blocks
formatting._comment_includeMetadata: Include conversation metadata (model, session ID, timestamps)
formatting._comment_includeToolCalls: Include tool calls and results in output

performance._comment_maxBufferSize: Maximum number of messages to buffer in memory before flushing
performance._comment_asyncWrites: Use async non-blocking file writes (recommended: true)

_comment_customFormatter: Path to custom formatter JavaScript file (optional)
